turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class before anyone called me: who decided that, and on what basis?
Thanks for coming in.
You're welcome. Now answer me, Hale: who entered that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Talk about it. You already graded it, Hale, so talking comes a week late. What is the zero based on?
How has his semester been at home?
We're not here about my home, Hale. We're here about a zero you entered on November 3 without calling me. I'm still waiting for the basis.
He seems tired in class lately.
"Seems tired." That's an impression, Hale, and an impression isn't a reason to give a seventeen-year-old a zero. Show me what you actually have, or I'm going to the principal when we're done.
I know he works at the grocery store.
And what does his job have to do with his essay? I'm writing that down: the teacher brought up his job before the evidence. Ten more seconds of this and I'm going upstairs, Hale.
The essay came in on time, which was good.
Then why are we here? On time, and still a zero. What's the basis, Hale?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Concerns aren't evidence. Name them, show me the document, or withdraw the zero.
The school's checker flagged it.

A machine's guess, then. Turnitin's own guide says the indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern; I have both printed in my bag. So what else do you have, Hale, or is that it?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." You knew that, and you entered the zero anyway, before speaking to me. Withdraw it, Hale.
I also looked at the version history.
Ten minutes. Then show me the version history, with dates and times, so I can read it myself. Turn the screen.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late" is an adjective, Hale, not a time. A file being created tells you when a document was opened, not when a student did his thinking. Exact timestamps, on the screen, now.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." People paste from their own notes every day; that proves nothing about who wrote them. How many words, at what times, and why am I still not looking at it?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
Afterward. After the zero went in on November 3, or before? Because procedure 4.1 says you speak to the student first, Hale.
He had trouble explaining it.

"Had trouble explaining it." A seventeen-year-old put on the spot by the teacher who's already failed him, and you're surprised he stumbled. You still haven't told me whether that conversation happened before or after the zero, Hale.
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Don't manage me, Hale. He has a zero in your gradebook, three weeks before his scholarship deadline; he's already in trouble. Is anything about this on his record right now, yes or no?
What do you think should happen next?

You're asking me how to do your job? The zero comes off today, Owen gets an apology for finding out on his phone in class, and you put in writing that nothing is on his file. Otherwise I'm in the principal's office at 4:41.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not you, Hale, and I'm not going to coach the person who failed my son. You have my terms. Answer them.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.

Two minutes. A rewrite means you're still treating this as a concern, Hale, and you haven't shown me a single dated page that would justify one. The zero comes off first; then we can discuss anything else.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
I'm writing that down: lunch, your room. It changes nothing until I've seen something with a date on it that I can check myself. Show me the version history now, Hale, or I'm going upstairs.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.

My call is waiting, Hale, so you have one minute. "If it holds up" isn't a promise, and nothing goes on Owen's file, full stop, in writing. The zero comes off today and I see every dated page you have, or I'm in the principal's office before my call ends.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. The zero comes off today, nothing goes on Owen's file in writing, and I see every dated page you have before anyone mentions a rewrite again.
Thanks for your time.
I'm not leaving yet. You still haven't told me whether the zero comes off today or whether I'm walking to the principal's office.
